summary: Backend-only verification of the Rahal inbound webhook bug fix (deactivated/deleted packages must disappear from the Meraaj market). Created 24 new targeted tests in /app/backend/tests/test_rahal_inbound_sync.py — ALL PASS — plus 3 robustness probes in test_rahal_webhook_edges.py (2 minor defects found). Full existing suite re-run: 104/104 passed, no regressions. Verified against the public preview URL and confirmed each result directly in MongoDB (packages.status, rahal_inbound_log).

minor.issue: Malformed JSON body with a VALID signature returns 500 Internal Server Error (json.loads called before try/except). Should be 400/422. Repro: POST raw b'{not-json' with correct HMAC.

Audit-log handled flag is unreliable on retries: the final `db.rahal_inbound_log.update_one({"body": event}, ...)` matches by body, so a duplicate delivery (identical body, e.g. Rahal retry) updates the FIRST log row and the newest row stays handled=false even though it was processed. Fix: capture the inserted_id from insert_one and update by _id.

Events for an unknown package_ref return handled=true even though matched_count==0 (nothing updated). Consider reporting matched_count / handled=false so missing-package sync gaps are visible in the log.

action_items: Wrap json.loads(raw) in the webhook handler and return HTTP 400 for malformed bodies instead of 500.
Update rahal_inbound_log by the inserted _id (not by body) so the handled flag is correct for duplicate/retried deliveries.
Optionally set handled=false (or log matched_count) when package_ref matches no package.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified fix is correct: package.deactivated/deleted/removed/disabled -> status 'unlisted', package.activated -> 'listed', and package.updated normalizes active/status into listed/unlisted while stripping foreign 'status'/'active' from the $set — no foreign status can leak into packages.status.
Signature enforcement is solid: missing, invalid, and tampered-body signatures all return 401 and leave the package untouched (hmac.compare_digest over exact raw bytes).

share_package auto-provisions the seller office and upserts by rahal_ref; note it $sets status back to 'listed' on every re-share, so a Rahal re-push of a previously deleted package will silently re-list it — confirm this is intended business behaviour.
integration.py is 300 lines and readable; no _id leakage observed (serialize used).

success_rate.backend: 97% (104/104 functional suite passed; 2/3 extra robustness probes failed as minor defects)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral rahal packages with refs prefixed TEST-QA-* under office_ref RHL-OFF-QA-TEST; every package and its rahal_inbound_log rows are deleted in fixture teardown. No seeded/production data touched.

Run serially with `-n 0` when debugging (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; `-p no:xdist` errors). DB assertions use pymongo with MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env. test_rahal_webhook_edges.py intentionally documents 2 open minor defects (500 on malformed JSON, handled-flag on duplicate bodies) and will keep failing until fixed.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: the webhook had no branch for package.deleted/removed/disabled, and package.updated copied Rahal's foreign 'status' verbatim into packages.status, so market.py's {status:'listed'} filter kept showing deleted packages. Current code adds the missing event branches, normalizes active/status into listed/unlisted, and excludes status/active from the raw $set. Verified end-to-end: shared package appears in GET /api/packages, and after a signed package.deleted webhook its DB status is 'unlisted' and it is absent from GET /api/packages.
